record.oneLiner: The first non-bird dinosaur found with feathers — and known colours.
record.description: Sinosauropteryx was a small coelurosaurian theropod of Early Cretaceous China with a long tail and short arms, about 1 m long. Described in 1996, it was the first dinosaur outside the bird lineage found with feathers — simple filaments — and preserved pigment shows it had a countershaded body and a banded tail.

notableFacts.text: The first non-avian dinosaur found with evidence of feathers.
Preserved pigment reveals a countershaded body and a banded 'raccoon' tail.
